body:
@KoBeWi Some thoughts (did not test it yet):
- Instead of permanent change, I could change it back to previous value (and save it into metadata - see last item of this list) when hiding the panel (I tried it a bit over the weekend, and at first glance it seems to work). Unfortunately, show/hide order of tabs (since the bottom panel is now a tab container) depends on order in tree (which may not be entirely obvious when using the tab container as a whole):
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8327dfa215aa1758f2c3b99a52934172b94c134e/scene/gui/tab_container.cpp#L324-L345
So if we have multiple tabs with this trick, it won't work (unless I'm missing something).
Can I change it to something like this?: 1) first hide all tabs (except the current/selected one?), 2) show only selected ones (outside of this for loop)?
- Previously, the visibility of the selected panel was changed first, and then the `split_offset` parameter was set from config (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109915#discussion_r2311314677):
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8327dfa215aa1758f2c3b99a52934172b94c134e/editor/editor_node.cpp#L6033-L6038
Right now in code the order is the same, but looks like real visibility change of the panel (tab in tab container) is deferred. So execution order was changed - first split_offset will be loaded from config, and then the code from `NOTIFICATION_VISIBILITY_CHANGED` will execute. And this line:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8327dfa215aa1758f2c3b99a52934172b94c134e/editor/audio/editor_audio_buses.cpp#L1164
is not true anymore.
I think theoretically I could make `center_split->set_split_offset(center_split_offset);` deferred.
- Proper `split_offset` should be saved into config. 
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8327dfa215aa1758f2c3b99a52934172b94c134e/editor/editor_node.cpp#L6015-L6016
Maybe instead of saving its direct value we could get meta (see first item of this list) with "old" size, with default return value set to `center_split->get_split_offset()`.
- Also, perhaps all the logic related to the "split_offset" parameter of the "center_split" node could be moved to the bottom panel altogether, instead of changing the "split_offset" in different places.

I would love to hear your thoughts on this!

Maybe the issue can be fixed using #111499 The Audio dock could be given some default size, only used when initializing the layout for the first time. Also the default minimum size of Audio tab is too small. It could be increased to at least show part of the volume bars, like
